people.name: Melchizedek
people.line: King of Salem and priest of God Most High.

translations.web: Yahweh has sworn, and will not change his mind: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”
translations.bsb: The LORD has sworn and will not change His mind: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”
translations.kjv: The LORD hath sworn, and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek.
translations.asv: Jehovah hath sworn, and will not repent: Thou art a priest for ever After the order of Melchizedek.
